zebrafish_somites_specimen.species: Danio rerio / Vertebrate embryo dorsal scanning electron micrograph showing central neural tube, presomitic mesoderm, and bilateral segmented somite metameres

lewis_2003_governing_equations.protein_dde: dp(t)/dt = a * m(t - T_p) - b * p(t)
lewis_2003_governing_equations.total_delay_invariance: T_tot = T_m + T_p  (time-shift p_tilde(t) = p(t + T_p) reduces the DDE system to a single lumped delay T_tot)
lewis_2003_governing_equations.hopf_critical_delay_condition: T_tot > T_crit, where T_crit = sqrt((omega^2 + b^2)*(omega^2 + c^2)) -> sustained limit-cycle oscillation for T_m + T_p > T_crit (~4.62 min)
lewis_2003_governing_equations.oscillation_period_law: T_osc = 2 * (T_m + T_p + tau_half_p + tau_half_m) ~ 2 * (T_m + T_p + ln(2)/b + ln(2)/c) ~ 30.0 min
lewis_2003_governing_equations.deltac_notch_intercellular_coupling: dm_i(t)/dt = k * [ (1 - eps_N) + eps_N * (p_delta_neighbor(t - T_N) / p_delta0)^m_N / (1 + (p_delta_neighbor(t - T_N) / p_delta0)^m_N) ] / (1 + (p_i(t - T_m) / p_0)^n) - c * m_i(t)

canonical_zebrafish_parameters_28C.species: Danio rerio (zebrafish presomitic mesoderm at 28.5 C)

lewis_2003_experimental_perturbations.source: Lewis (2003) Current Biology 13:1398-1408 Table 1, Box 1 & Figs. 2-6; Giudicelli et al. (2007) PLoS Biology 5:e150; Herrgen et al. (2010) Current Biology 20:1244-1253

regimes.label: Wild-type Danio rerio PSM oscillator (her1/her7 feedback + DeltaC-Notch coupling at 28 C)
Pure her7 fast feedback loop (short gene delay T_m = 4.6 min, T_p = 1.7 min)
Pure her1 slow feedback loop (long gene delay T_m = 9.5 min, T_p = 2.8 min)
DeltaC-Notch intercellular delay elevation (Herrgen et al. 2010 collective period lengthening)
Subcritical delay (T_tot = 2.0 min < T_crit) or Cycloheximide translation block (a = 0 -> damped/arrested clock)
